entries.set_purpose: One four-step rehearsal retains comfortable upright organization and opposite arm/leg timing while the later run receives the effort decision. The quiet-standing replacement observes only its own simpler participation.

entries.advance_hold_reduce: Retain four individual steps, two each side,2s each plus2s settle. P1 recovery is20s before repeating this short pattern. Do not increase height, travel, flight or count because effort may change later.

standard_D.variant: Basic alternating march in place — explicit stationary teaching adaptation
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10. Two seconds per comfortable walking-height step; four alternating steps, two each side, then settle2s. Use relaxed opposite arm/leg timing without a forced thigh-height target.
standard_D.notes: One foot remains supported; no flight or forward travel. Each left/right step is one count, not a two-step cycle. This is the same basic pattern used in the instructional preparation; it is not exact traveling A-March or sprint exposure.

entries.set_purpose: Each listed run practices smooth buildup and relaxed rhythm at one selected effort on the retained route. The purposeful branch teaches its first2→4/4 attempt only after repeatable prior2→3/3 running and suitable slowing. The easy branch retains or teaches the existing easy task. Two standard D or one compressed D opportunities, before a smaller cap, share that same purpose; there is no faster second-round target.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual OR04 easy-run/route evidence plus OR07 or other recent lower-body response → one justified modest effort decision or retained easy/alternate task → OR12 keeps actual output/route while teaching recovery responsibility → OR16 compares the actual retained task without claiming maximal speed.
entries.advance_hold_reduce: Change only a justified intent cue from actual2→3/3 to2→4/4. Hold the actual start,35m geometry, opportunities, full recovery and familiar strength demands. Main referenceD2standard/1compressed,Lwalking1standard/0compressed; cap1 preserves actual smaller prior opportunities. Never restore a missing run or turn the second round into a faster test. If actual recent intent was already4/10, record a hold, not a new increase; this reference does not prescribe higher output.

standard_D.variant: Progressive Build and Upright Rhythm Run — modest nonmaximal intent context
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight. From still comfortable standing, build smoothly over0–10m from about2/10 toward4/10, then keep relaxed purposeful4/10 through10–20m. Slow gradually through20–35m. This is a provisional coaching effort cue, not a speed percentage, required pace or maximal/flying sprint.
standard_D.notes: Each set is one whole counted attempt including any fault. Active/exit estimate25s; separate outside walking return40s. These are logistics estimates, not forced cadence. No corrective or assessment repetition is added. Exact steps/contacts and return metres remain actual observations. Retain the actual smaller compatible opportunity count. All25s active phases are planning allowances, not segment targets; earlier clearance leaves quiet time. The full40s outside return includes turning/rejoining. Longer actual action/return delays later releases; omit uncompleted later work instead of forcing pace. Record actual effort, slowing and faults; no extra trial.

entries.advance_hold_reduce: One set; D3/4/4 or L2/3/3 across9–11/12–14/15–18 only when compatible with actual recent counts. Explicit1/2/3 ceilings use min(reference,cap). Keep3s lower,1s pause,1s stand,5s setup,60s recovery and at least5 good reps in reserve. The smaller actual dose stays smaller.

entries.set_purpose: One supporting hip set retains the most recent compatible pattern and dose. Bodyweight remains bodyweight after actual OR07 unloading. A genuinely familiar currently retained two-DB set can remain loaded if its own handling, supervision and recent-history conditions hold; neither choice adds a new strength progression.
entries.prior_current_next: Most recent actual OR06/07 or equivalent hip variant, handling, load, repetitions and response → one compatible retained/reduced set → OR10/15 use actual response and the earlier productive record while preserving more recent reductions.
entries.advance_hold_reduce: One set only. Bodyweight D3/4/4,L2/3/3 at4s each+5s handling,60s rest. Familiar DB D3/4/4 in either booking at4s each+10s complete handling,90s rest and at least5 good reps in reserve; zero loaded sets inL. Explicit1/2/3 repetition ceilings preserve actual smaller counts in either variant. No first loaded setup, extra set or load restoration accompanies a new running-intent lesson.

standard_D.variant: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Good Morning — arms crossed at chest
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight;3s hips back/1s stand, at least5 good reps in reserve. Retain the actual comfortable range and arm position.
standard_D.notes: OR08 uses the most recent actual hip record, not the latest older DB record. If actual OR07 unloaded the hinge, retain its unloaded variant/count; renewed DBs are not called retention. One first-DB teaching set alone does not establish the familiar10s handling profile.
